faq.title: Everything worth knowing
faq.subtitle: If something is missing here, message us on Instagram.

q1.q: How do I place an order?
q1.a: Add what you need to the cart, then fill in your name, phone, wilaya and commune. No account needed. You pay the driver in cash when the box arrives.

q2.a: Two to four days for the north, four to seven for the south. We call you to confirm before anything ships.

q3.a: It depends on your wilaya and whether you choose home delivery or a stop desk. The exact figure appears at checkout as soon as you pick your wilaya.

q4.q: How do I use the card that came in my pack?
q4.a: Create an account on the course platform, then type the code printed on the card. Your modules open straight away, with no manual check.

q5.q: Can I get course access without buying a pack?
q5.a: Yes. Create an account, copy the RIP number shown on screen, send the transfer from Baridimob, then upload the receipt. An admin reviews it within 24 to 48 hours.

q6.q: Can I download the course files?
q6.a: No. Resources open in the browser and stay there. Downloading is off unless an admin turns it on for a specific document.

q7.q: My order has not arrived. What now?
q7.a: Message us on Instagram at @trendyplaza_architecture or call, with your order reference. We chase the courier and tell you what we find.

q8.q: Can I change or cancel an order?
q8.a: Yes, any time before it leaves for delivery. Call or send a message with your reference.

aboutPage.heroLede: From a single Instagram page to 9,000+ students across Algeria. Studio supplies, printed packs and online courses — everything in one place.
aboutPage.offerSectionLede: Buy a printed pack and your course access is already inside — no second payment, no waiting.
aboutPage.offerCard1Body: Every item is from an actual reading list or studio session — sourced from EPAU, USTHB and faculties across all 69 wilayas.
aboutPage.offerCard2Title: Buy a pack. Get 100% off the LMS.
aboutPage.teamSubtitle: The people behind the packs, the courses and the deliveries.
aboutPage.offerCard2Body: Your access code is sealed inside every pack. Open your courses the moment the box arrives.
aboutPage.offerCard3Body: University · Year · Semester · Module. Lectures, past papers, corrections. Open in any browser, any device.
aboutPage.title: We sell what we needed when we were the ones sitting the exams
aboutPage.lede: Trendy Plaza started as an Instagram page answering the same question over and over: where does a student in Algiers find a drawing tube that does not collapse in a taxi. Nine thousand students later it is a shop and a course library, run by people who did the same degree.
aboutPage.originBody: One of us was in second year, spending more time hunting for a decent set square than drawing with one. The good shops were in one wilaya. The rest of the country paid postage on guesswork, or went without. So we started posting what we had actually used and what we had actually thrown away, and people started asking to buy it.
aboutPage.catalogueBody: Because a long one would be dishonest. Everything listed here is on a real reading list or in a real studio, and we have used most of it ourselves. When something turns out to be badly made we stop selling it rather than discounting it.
aboutPage.coursesBody: The printed packs came first. Students kept photographing pages to send to friends in other wilayas, which told us the material mattered more than the paper. So the same notes went online, filed the way a school files them: university, year, semester, module. The card in the pack is what opens them.
aboutPage.deliveryBody: Almost no student in Algeria has a bank card, and asking for one would exclude most of the people this is for. You pay the driver when the box arrives. We call before anything ships, because a wrong address costs everyone a week.
aboutPage.value1Body: The number of students, the delivery windows, the wilayas covered. If it is on this site we can point at where it comes from.
aboutPage.value2Body: English, Arabic and French across the whole product, not a translated homepage and an English checkout.
aboutPage.value3Body: A course you paid for stays reachable. Archiving hides material from the shelf; it never removes it from an account that already has it.
aboutPage.value4Body: Instagram, phone, email, seven days. Usually within the hour, and always by a person who knows the catalogue.
aboutPage.statWilayasNote: every one of them, north and south
aboutPage.ctaTitle: Come and look at the shop
aboutPage.ctaBody: Or read what is in the course library before you decide.
aboutPage.contactBody: Instagram is fastest. Phone works too, and someone picks up.
